ayahs.arabic: طه
ayahs.translit: Taha

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Ta, Ha

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِتَشۡقَىٰٓ
ayahs.translit: Ma anzalna AAalayka alqurana litashqa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا تَذۡكِرَةࣰ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Illa tathkiratan liman yakhsha

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah]

ayahs.arabic: تَنزِيلࣰ ا مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلۡعُلَى
ayahs.translit: Tanzeelan mimman khalaqa alarda waalssamawati alAAula

t.eng-ummmuhammad: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens

ayahs.arabic: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Alrrahmanu AAala alAAarshi istawa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established

ayahs.arabic: لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحۡتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wama baynahuma wama tahta alththara

t.eng-ummmuhammad: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن تَجۡهَرۡ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخۡفَى
ayahs.translit: Wain tajhar bialqawli fainnahu yaAAlamu alssirra waakhfa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden

ayahs.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa lahu alasmao alhusna

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names

ayahs.arabic: وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
ayahs.translit: Wahal ataka hadeethu moosa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And has the story of Moses reached you

ayahs.arabic: إِذۡ رَءَا نَارࣰ ا فَقَالَ لِأَهۡلِهِ ٱمۡكُثُوٓاْ إِنِّيٓ ءَانَسۡتُ نَارࣰ ا لَّعَلِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنۡهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوۡ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدࣰ ى
ayahs.translit: Ith raa naran faqala liahlihi omkuthoo innee anastu naran laAAallee ateekum minha biqabasin aw ajidu AAala alnnari hudan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِيَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ
ayahs.translit: Falamma ataha noodiya ya moosa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّيٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخۡلَعۡ نَعۡلَيۡكَ إِنَّكَ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوࣰ ى
ayahs.translit: Innee ana rabbuka faikhlaAA naAAlayka innaka bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَا ٱخۡتَرۡتُكَ فَٱسۡتَمِعۡ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
ayahs.translit: Waana ikhtartuka faistamiAA lima yooha

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you]

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّنِيٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعۡبُدۡنِي وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكۡرِيٓ
ayahs.translit: Innanee ana Allahu la ilaha illa ana faoAAbudnee waaqimi alssalata lithikree

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخۡفِيهَا لِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا تَسۡعَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Inna alssaAAata atiyatun akadu okhfeeha litujza kullu nafsin bima tasAAa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنۡهَا مَن لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرۡدَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Fala yasuddannaka AAanha man la yuminu biha waittabaAAa hawahu fatarda

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تِلۡكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Wama tilka biyameenika ya moosa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَ أَتَوَكَّؤُاْ عَلَيۡهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِي وَلِيَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخۡرَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qala hiya AAasaya atawakkao AAalayha waahushshu biha AAala ghanamee waliya feeha maaribu okhra

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَلۡقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qala alqiha ya moosa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Allah] said, "Throw it down, O Moses

ayahs.arabic: فَأَلۡقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةࣱ تَسۡعَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Faalqaha faitha hiya hayyatun tasAAa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ خُذۡهَا وَلَا تَخَفۡۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qala khuthha wala takhaf sanuAAeeduha seerataha aloola

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition

ayahs.arabic: وَٱضۡمُمۡ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخۡرَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Waodmum yadaka ila janahika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin ayatan okhra

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign

ayahs.arabic: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلۡكُبۡرَى
ayahs.translit: Linuriyaka min ayatina alkubra

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs

ayahs.arabic: ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Ithhab ila firAAawna innahu tagha

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي
ayahs.translit: Qala rabbi ishrah lee sadree

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance]

ayahs.arabic: وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي
ayahs.translit: Wayassir lee amree

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And ease for me my task

ayahs.arabic: وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةࣰ مِّن لِّسَانِي
ayahs.translit: Waohlul AAuqdatan min lisanee

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And untie the knot from my tongue

ayahs.arabic: يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِي
ayahs.translit: Yafqahoo qawlee

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That they may understand my speech

ayahs.arabic: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي وَزِيرࣰ ا مِّنۡ أَهۡلِي
ayahs.translit: WaijAAal lee wazeeran min ahlee

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And appoint for me a minister from my family

ayahs.arabic: هَٰرُونَ أَخِي
ayahs.translit: Haroona akhee

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Aaron, my brother

ayahs.arabic: ٱشۡدُدۡ بِهِۦٓ أَزۡرِي
ayahs.translit: Oshdud bihi azree

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Increase through him my strength

ayahs.arabic: وَأَشۡرِكۡهُ فِيٓ أَمۡرِي
ayahs.translit: Waashrikhu fee amree

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And let him share my task

ayahs.arabic: كَيۡ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Kay nusabbihaka katheeran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That we may exalt You much

ayahs.arabic: وَنَذۡكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
ayahs.translit: Wanathkuraka katheeran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And remember You much

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Innaka kunta bina baseeran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ قَدۡ أُوتِيتَ سُؤۡلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qala qad ooteeta sulaka ya moosa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Allah] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَيۡكَ مَرَّةً أُخۡرَىٰٓ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad mananna AAalayka marratan okhra

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time

ayahs.arabic: إِذۡ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
ayahs.translit: Ith awhayna ila ommika ma yooha

t.eng-ummmuhammad: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired

ayahs.arabic: أَنِ ٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ فَلۡيُلۡقِهِ ٱلۡيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأۡخُذۡهُ عَدُوࣱّ لِّي وَعَدُوࣱّ لَّهُۥۚ وَأَلۡقَيۡتُ عَلَيۡكَ مَحَبَّةࣰ مِّنِّي وَلِتُصۡنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيۡنِيٓ
ayahs.translit: Ani iqthifeehi fee alttabooti faiqthifeehi fee alyammi falyulqihi alyammu bialssahili yakhuthhu AAaduwwun lee waAAaduwwun lahu waalqaytu AAalayka mahabbatan minnee walitusnaAAa AAala AAaynee

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye

ayahs.arabic: إِذۡ تَمۡشِيٓ أُخۡتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكۡفُلُهُۥۖ فَرَجَعۡنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَۚ وَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسࣰ ا فَنَجَّيۡنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونࣰ اۚ فَلَبِثۡتَ سِنِينَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئۡتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرࣲ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Ith tamshee okhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum AAala man yakfuluhu farajaAAnaka ila ommika kay taqarra AAaynuha wala tahzana waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynaka mina alghammi wafatannaka futoonan falabithta sineena fee ahli madyana thumma jita AAala qadarin ya moosa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses

ayahs.arabic: وَٱصۡطَنَعۡتُكَ لِنَفۡسِي
ayahs.translit: WaistanaAAtuka linafsee

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And I produced you for Myself

ayahs.arabic: ٱذۡهَبۡ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِي وَلَا تَنِيَا فِي ذِكۡرِي
ayahs.translit: Ithhab anta waakhooka biayatee wala taniya fee thikree

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance

ayahs.arabic: ٱذۡهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Ithhaba ila firAAawna innahu tagha

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed

ayahs.arabic: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوۡلࣰ ا لَّيِّنࣰ ا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوۡ يَخۡشَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Faqoola lahu qawlan layyinan laAAallahu yatathakkaru aw yakhsha

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah]

ayahs.arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفۡرُطَ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوۡ أَن يَطۡغَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qala rabbana innana nakhafu an yafruta AAalayna aw an yatgha

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآۖ إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَآ أَسۡمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qala la takhafa innanee maAAakuma asmaAAu waara

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Allah] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see

ayahs.arabic: فَأۡتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبۡهُمۡۖ قَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةࣲ مِّن رَّبِّكَۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
ayahs.translit: Fatiyahu faqoola inna rasoola rabbika faarsil maAAana banee israeela wala tuAAaththibhum qad jinaka biayatin min rabbika waalssalamu AAala mani ittabaAAa alhuda

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا قَدۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡنَآ أَنَّ ٱلۡعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.translit: Inna qad oohiya ilayna anna alAAathaba AAala man kaththaba watawalla

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qala faman rabbukuma ya moosa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَعۡطَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلۡقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qala rabbuna allathee aAAta kulla shayin khalqahu thumma hada

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلۡقُرُونِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qala fama balu alqurooni aloola

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ عِلۡمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَٰبࣲۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّي وَلَا يَنسَى
ayahs.translit: Qala AAilmuha AAinda rabbee fee kitabin la yadillu rabbee wala yansa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَهۡدࣰ ا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا سُبُلࣰ ا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجࣰ ا مِّن نَّبَاتࣲ شَتَّىٰ
ayahs.translit: Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda mahdan wasalaka lakum feeha subulan waanzala mina alssamai maan faakhrajna bihi azwajan min nabatin shatta

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants

ayahs.arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱرۡعَوۡاْ أَنۡعَٰمَكُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلنُّهَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Kuloo wairAAaw anAAamakum inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed, in that are signs for those of intelligence

ayahs.arabic: ۞مِنۡهَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا نُخۡرِجُكُمۡ تَارَةً أُخۡرَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Minha khalaqnakum wafeeha nuAAeedukum waminha nukhrijukum taratan okhra

t.eng-ummmuhammad: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرَيۡنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad araynahu ayatina kullaha fakaththaba waaba

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We certainly showed Pharaoh Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَجِئۡتَنَا لِتُخۡرِجَنَا مِنۡ أَرۡضِنَا بِسِحۡرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qala ajitana litukhrijana min ardina bisihrika ya moosa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses

ayahs.arabic: فَلَنَأۡتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحۡرࣲ مِّثۡلِهِۦ فَٱجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكَ مَوۡعِدࣰ ا لَّا نُخۡلِفُهُۥ نَحۡنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانࣰ ا سُوࣰ ى
ayahs.translit: Falanatiyannaka bisihrin mithlihi faijAAal baynana wabaynaka mawAAidan la nukhlifuhu nahnu wala anta makanan suwan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ مَوۡعِدُكُمۡ يَوۡمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحۡشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحࣰ ى
ayahs.translit: Qala mawAAidukum yawmu alzzeenati waan yuhshara alnnasu duhan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning

ayahs.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيۡدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Fatawalla firAAawnu fajamaAAa kaydahu thumma ata

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses]

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيۡلَكُمۡ لَا تَفۡتَرُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبࣰ ا فَيُسۡحِتَكُم بِعَذَابࣲۖ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qala lahum moosa waylakum la taftaroo AAala Allahi kathiban fayushitakum biAAathabin waqad khaba mani iftara

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Moses said to the magicians summoned by Pharaoh, "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allah or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]

ayahs.arabic: فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّجۡوَىٰ
ayahs.translit: FatanazaAAoo amrahum baynahum waasarroo alnnajwa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخۡرِجَاكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِمَا وَيَذۡهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلۡمُثۡلَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo in hathani lasahirani yureedani an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihima wayathhaba bitareeqatikumu almuthla

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way

ayahs.arabic: فَأَجۡمِعُواْ كَيۡدَكُمۡ ثُمَّ ٱئۡتُواْ صَفࣰّ اۚ وَقَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مَنِ ٱسۡتَعۡلَىٰ
ayahs.translit: FaajmiAAoo kaydakum thumma itoo saffan waqad aflaha alyawma mani istaAAla

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلۡقِيَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنۡ أَلۡقَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo ya moosa imma an tulqiya waimma an nakoona awwala man alqa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ بَلۡ أَلۡقُواْۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمۡ وَعِصِيُّهُمۡ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيۡهِ مِن سِحۡرِهِمۡ أَنَّهَا تَسۡعَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qala bal alqoo faitha hibaluhum waAAisiyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min sihrihim annaha tasAAa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes]

ayahs.arabic: فَأَوۡجَسَ فِي نَفۡسِهِۦ خِيفَةࣰ مُّوسَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Faawjasa fee nafsihi kheefatan moosa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡنَا لَا تَخَفۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qulna la takhaf innaka anta alaAAla

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Allah said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior

ayahs.arabic: وَأَلۡقِ مَا فِي يَمِينِكَ تَلۡقَفۡ مَا صَنَعُوٓاْۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُواْ كَيۡدُ سَٰحِرࣲۖ وَلَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيۡثُ أَتَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Waalqi ma fee yameenika talqaf ma sanaAAoo innama sanaAAoo kaydu sahirin wala yuflihu alssahiru haythu ata

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is

ayahs.arabic: فَأُلۡقِيَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدࣰ ا قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Faolqiya alssaharatu sujjadan qaloo amanna birabbi haroona wamoosa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفࣲ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ فِي جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخۡلِ وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابࣰ ا وَأَبۡقَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falaoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum fee juthooAAi alnnakhli walataAAlamunna ayyuna ashaddu AAathaban waabqa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ لَن نُّؤۡثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنَاۖ فَٱقۡضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍۖ إِنَّمَا تَقۡضِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَآ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo lan nuthiraka AAala ma jaana mina albayyinati waallathee fatarana faiqdi ma anta qadin innama taqdee hathihi alhayata alddunya

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us. So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغۡفِرَ لَنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَا وَمَآ أَكۡرَهۡتَنَا عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحۡرِۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرࣱ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ
ayahs.translit: Inna amanna birabbina liyaghfira lana khatayana wama akrahtana AAalayhi mina alssihri waAllahu khayrun waabqa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allah is better and more enduring

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَأۡتِ رَبَّهُۥ مُجۡرِمࣰ ا فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Innahu man yati rabbahu mujriman fainna lahu jahannama la yamootu feeha wala yahya

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن يَأۡتِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنࣰ ا قَدۡ عَمِلَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتُ ٱلۡعُلَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Waman yatihi muminan qad AAamila alssalihati faolaika lahumu alddarajatu alAAula

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]

ayahs.arabic: جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.translit: Jannatu AAadnin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wathalika jazao man tazakka

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي فَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ طَرِيقࣰ ا فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ يَبَسࣰ ا لَّا تَخَٰفُ دَرَكࣰ ا وَلَا تَخۡشَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad awhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee faidrib lahum tareeqan fee albahri yabasan la takhafu darakan wala takhsha

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]

ayahs.arabic: فَأَتۡبَعَهُمۡ فِرۡعَوۡنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمۡ
ayahs.translit: FaatbaAAahum firAAawnu bijunoodihi faghashiyahum mina alyammi ma ghashiyahum

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them

ayahs.arabic: وَأَضَلَّ فِرۡعَوۡنُ قَوۡمَهُۥ وَمَا هَدَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Waadalla firAAawnu qawmahu wama hada

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them]

ayahs.arabic: يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدۡ أَنجَيۡنَٰكُم مِّنۡ عَدُوِّكُمۡ وَوَٰعَدۡنَٰكُمۡ جَانِبَ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلۡأَيۡمَنَ وَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلۡوَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Ya banee israeela qad anjaynakum min AAaduwwikum wawaAAadnakum janiba alttoori alaymana wanazzalna AAalaykumu almanna waalssalwa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails

ayahs.arabic: كُلُواْ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنَٰكُمۡ وَلَا تَطۡغَوۡاْ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبِيۖ وَمَن يَحۡلِلۡ عَلَيۡهِ غَضَبِي فَقَدۡ هَوَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Kuloo min tayyibati ma razaqnakum wala tatghaw feehi fayahilla AAalaykum ghadabee waman yahlil AAalayhi ghadabee faqad hawa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنِّي لَغَفَّارࣱ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحࣰ ا ثُمَّ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Wainnee laghaffarun liman taba waamana waAAamila salihan thumma ihtada

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance

ayahs.arabic: ۞وَمَآ أَعۡجَلَكَ عَن قَوۡمِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Wama aAAjalaka AAan qawmika ya moosa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Allah] said, "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هُمۡ أُوْلَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِي وَعَجِلۡتُ إِلَيۡكَ رَبِّ لِتَرۡضَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qala hum olai AAala atharee waAAajiltu ilayka rabbi litarda

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَوۡمَكَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِيُّ
ayahs.translit: Qala fainna qad fatanna qawmaka min baAAdika waadallahumu alssamiriyyu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Allah] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Samiri has led them astray

ayahs.arabic: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ غَضۡبَٰنَ أَسِفࣰ اۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَلَمۡ يَعِدۡكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ وَعۡدًا حَسَنًاۚ أَفَطَالَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡعَهۡدُ أَمۡ أَرَدتُّمۡ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبࣱ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ فَأَخۡلَفۡتُم مَّوۡعِدِي
ayahs.translit: FarajaAAa moosa ila qawmihi ghadbana asifan qala ya qawmi alam yaAAidkum rabbukum waAAdan hasanan afatala AAalaykumu alAAahdu am aradtum an yahilla AAalaykum ghadabun min rabbikum faakhlaftum mawAAidee

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved. He said, "O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise? Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ مَآ أَخۡلَفۡنَا مَوۡعِدَكَ بِمَلۡكِنَا وَلَٰكِنَّا حُمِّلۡنَآ أَوۡزَارࣰ ا مِّن زِينَةِ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ فَقَذَفۡنَٰهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلۡقَى ٱلسَّامِرِيُّ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo ma akhlafna mawAAidaka bimalkina walakinna hummilna awzaran min zeenati alqawmi faqathafnaha fakathalika alqa alssamiriyyu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Samiri throw

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخۡرَجَ لَهُمۡ عِجۡلࣰ ا جَسَدࣰ ا لَّهُۥ خُوَارࣱ فَقَالُواْ هَٰذَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ وَإِلَٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِيَ
ayahs.translit: Faakhraja lahum AAijlan jasadan lahu khuwarun faqaloo hatha ilahukum wailahu moosa fanasiya

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, "This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot

ayahs.arabic: أَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ أَلَّا يَرۡجِعُ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَوۡلࣰ ا وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ لَهُمۡ ضَرࣰّ ا وَلَا نَفۡعࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Afala yarawna alla yarjiAAu ilayhim qawlan wala yamliku lahum darran wala nafAAan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ هَٰرُونُ مِن قَبۡلُ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ فَٱتَّبِعُونِي وَأَطِيعُوٓاْ أَمۡرِي
ayahs.translit: Walaqad qala lahum haroonu min qablu ya qawmi innama futintum bihi wainna rabbakumu alrrahmanu faittabiAAoonee waateeAAoo amree

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ لَن نَّبۡرَحَ عَلَيۡهِ عَٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرۡجِعَ إِلَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo lan nabraha AAalayhi AAakifeena hatta yarjiAAa ilayna moosa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "We will never cease being devoted to the calf until Moses returns to us

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَٰهَٰرُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذۡ رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ ضَلُّوٓاْ
ayahs.translit: Qala ya haroonu ma manaAAaka ith raaytahum dalloo

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray

ayahs.arabic: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِۖ أَفَعَصَيۡتَ أَمۡرِي
ayahs.translit: Alla tattabiAAani afaAAasayta amree

t.eng-ummmuhammad: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَبۡنَؤُمَّ لَا تَأۡخُذۡ بِلِحۡيَتِي وَلَا بِرَأۡسِيٓۖ إِنِّي خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقۡتَ بَيۡنَ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمۡ تَرۡقُبۡ قَوۡلِي
ayahs.translit: Qala ya bna omma la takhuth bilihyatee wala birasee innee khasheetu an taqoola farraqta bayna banee israeela walam tarqub qawlee

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكَ يَٰسَٰمِرِيُّ
ayahs.translit: Qala fama khatbuka ya samiriyyu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Samiri

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ بَصُرۡتُ بِمَا لَمۡ يَبۡصُرُواْ بِهِۦ فَقَبَضۡتُ قَبۡضَةࣰ مِّنۡ أَثَرِ ٱلرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذۡتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتۡ لِي نَفۡسِي
ayahs.translit: Qala basurtu bima lam yabsuroo bihi faqabadtu qabdatan min athari alrrasooli fanabathtuha wakathalika sawwalat lee nafsee

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَٱذۡهَبۡ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوۡعِدࣰ ا لَّن تُخۡلَفَهُۥۖ وَٱنظُرۡ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِي ظَلۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ عَاكِفࣰ اۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ نَسۡفًا
ayahs.translit: Qala faithhab fainna laka fee alhayati an taqoola la misasa wainna laka mawAAidan lan tukhlafahu waonthur ila ilahika allathee thalta AAalayhi AAakifan lanuharriqannahu thumma lanansifannahu fee alyammi nasfan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it into the sea with a blast

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Innama ilahukumu Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa wasiAAa kulla shayin AAilman

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Your god is only Allah, except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge

ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ أَنۢبَآءِ مَا قَدۡ سَبَقَۚ وَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Kathalika naqussu AAalayka min anbai ma qad sabaqa waqad ataynaka min ladunna thikran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Thus, [O Muhammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us the Qur'an

ayahs.arabic: مَّنۡ أَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَحۡمِلُ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وِزۡرًا
ayahs.translit: Man aAArada AAanhu fainnahu yahmilu yawma alqiyamati wizran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden

ayahs.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهِۖ وَسَآءَ لَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ حِمۡلࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Khalideena feehi wasaa lahum yawma alqiyamati himlan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِۚ وَنَحۡشُرُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ زُرۡقࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori wanahshuru almujrimeena yawmaithin zurqan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed

ayahs.arabic: يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ إِن لَّبِثۡتُمۡ إِلَّا عَشۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Yatakhafatoona baynahum in labithtum illa AAashran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]

ayahs.arabic: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذۡ يَقُولُ أَمۡثَلُهُمۡ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثۡتُمۡ إِلَّا يَوۡمࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona ith yaqoolu amthaluhum tareeqatan in labithtum illa yawman

t.eng-ummmuhammad: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner will say, "You remained not but one day

ayahs.arabic: وَيَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلۡجِبَالِ فَقُلۡ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّي نَسۡفࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Wayasaloonaka AAani aljibali faqul yansifuha rabbee nasfan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast

ayahs.arabic: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعࣰ ا صَفۡصَفࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Fayatharuha qaAAan safsafan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And He will leave the earth a level plain

ayahs.arabic: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجࣰ ا وَلَآ أَمۡتࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: La tara feeha AAiwajan wala amtan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلدَّاعِيَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُۥۖ وَخَشَعَتِ ٱلۡأَصۡوَاتُ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ فَلَا تَسۡمَعُ إِلَّا هَمۡسࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Yawmaithin yattabiAAoona alddaAAiya la AAiwaja lahu wakhashaAAati alaswatu lilrrahmani fala tasmaAAu illa hamsan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That Day, everyone will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps]

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لَّا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَرَضِيَ لَهُۥ قَوۡلࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Yawmaithin la tanfaAAu alshshafaAAatu illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waradiya lahu qawlan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word

ayahs.arabic: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yuheetoona bihi AAilman

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Allah knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it in knowledge

ayahs.arabic: ۞وَعَنَتِ ٱلۡوُجُوهُ لِلۡحَيِّ ٱلۡقَيُّومِۖ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنۡ حَمَلَ ظُلۡمࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: WaAAanati alwujoohu lilhayyi alqayyoomi waqad khaba man hamala thulman

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. And he will have failed who carries injustice

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنࣱ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلۡمࣰ ا وَلَا هَضۡمࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waman yaAAmal mina alssalihati wahuwa muminun fala yakhafu thulman wala hadman

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيࣰّ ا وَصَرَّفۡنَا فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلۡوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ أَوۡ يُحۡدِثُ لَهُمۡ ذِكۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Wakathalika anzalnahu quranan AAarabiyyan wasarrafna feehi mina alwaAAeedi laAAallahum yattaqoona aw yuhdithu lahum thikran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance

ayahs.arabic: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡحَقُّۗ وَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يُقۡضَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكَ وَحۡيُهُۥۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدۡنِي عِلۡمࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu wala taAAjal bialqurani min qabli an yuqda ilayka wahyuhu waqul rabbi zidnee AAilman

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So high [above all] is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ عَهِدۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ مِن قَبۡلُ فَنَسِيَ وَلَمۡ نَجِدۡ لَهُۥ عَزۡمࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Walaqad AAahidna ila adama min qablu fanasiya walam najid lahu AAazman

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسۡجُدُواْ لِأٓدَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Waith qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa aba

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused

ayahs.arabic: فَقُلۡنَا يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ إِنَّ هَٰذَا عَدُوࣱّ لَّكَ وَلِزَوۡجِكَ فَلَا يُخۡرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ فَتَشۡقَىٰٓ
ayahs.translit: Faqulna ya adamu inna hatha AAaduwwun laka walizawjika fala yukhrijannakuma mina aljannati fatashqa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعۡرَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Inna laka alla tajooAAa feeha wala taAAra

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظۡمَؤُاْ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضۡحَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Waannaka la tathmao feeha wala tadha

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun

ayahs.arabic: فَوَسۡوَسَ إِلَيۡهِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ قَالَ يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ وَمُلۡكࣲ لَّا يَبۡلَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Fawaswasa ilayhi alshshaytanu qala ya adamu hal adulluka AAala shajarati alkhuldi wamulkin la yabla

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate

ayahs.arabic: فَأَكَلَا مِنۡهَا فَبَدَتۡ لَهُمَا سَوۡءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخۡصِفَانِ عَلَيۡهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلۡجَنَّةِۚ وَعَصَىٰٓ ءَادَمُ رَبَّهُۥ فَغَوَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Faakala minha fabadat lahuma sawatuhuma watafiqa yakhsifani AAalayhima min waraqi aljannati waAAasa adamu rabbahu faghawa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And Adam and his wife ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱجۡتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡهِ وَهَدَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Thumma ijtabahu rabbuhu fataba AAalayhi wahada

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him]

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ ٱهۡبِطَا مِنۡهَا جَمِيعَۢاۖ بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوࣱّۖ فَإِمَّا يَأۡتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّي هُدࣰ ى فَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشۡقَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qala ihbita minha jameeAAan baAAdukum libaAAdin AAaduwwun faimma yatiyannakum minnee hudan famani ittabaAAa hudaya fala yadillu wala yashqa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Allah] said, "Descend from Paradise - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter]

ayahs.arabic: وَمَنۡ أَعۡرَضَ عَن ذِكۡرِي فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةࣰ ضَنكࣰ ا وَنَحۡشُرُهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ أَعۡمَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Waman aAArada AAan thikree fainna lahu maAAeeshatan dankan wanahshuruhu yawma alqiyamati aAAman

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed life, and We will gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرۡتَنِيٓ أَعۡمَىٰ وَقَدۡ كُنتُ بَصِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Qala rabbi lima hashartanee aAAma waqad kuntu baseeran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ أَتَتۡكَ ءَايَٰتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَاۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُنسَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qala kathalika atatka ayatuna fanaseetaha wakathalika alyawma tunsa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Allah] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَنۡ أَسۡرَفَ وَلَمۡ يُؤۡمِنۢ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦۚ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ
ayahs.translit: Wakathalika najzee man asrafa walam yumin biayati rabbihi walaAAathabu alakhirati ashaddu waabqa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring

ayahs.arabic: أَفَلَمۡ يَهۡدِ لَهُمۡ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ يَمۡشُونَ فِي مَسَٰكِنِهِمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلنُّهَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni yamshoona fee masakinihim inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةࣱ سَبَقَتۡ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامࣰ ا وَأَجَلࣱ مُّسَمࣰّ ى
ayahs.translit: Walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika lakana lizaman waajalun musamman

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, punishment would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed]

ayahs.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ غُرُوبِهَاۖ وَمِنۡ ءَانَآيِٕ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡ وَأَطۡرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرۡضَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla ghuroobiha wamin anai allayli fasabbih waatrafa alnnahari laAAallaka tarda

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجࣰ ا مِّنۡهُمۡ زَهۡرَةَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا لِنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَرِزۡقُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرࣱ وَأَبۡقَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Wala tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum zahrata alhayati alddunya linaftinahum feehi warizqu rabbika khayrun waabqa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring

ayahs.arabic: وَأۡمُرۡ أَهۡلَكَ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ عَلَيۡهَاۖ لَا نَسۡـَٔلُكَ رِزۡقࣰ اۖ نَّحۡنُ نَرۡزُقُكَۗ وَٱلۡعَٰقِبَةُ لِلتَّقۡوَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Wamur ahlaka bialssalati waistabir AAalayha la nasaluka rizqan nahnu narzuquka waalAAaqibatu lilttaqwa

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا يَأۡتِينَا بِـَٔايَةࣲ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓۚ أَوَلَمۡ تَأۡتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِي ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Waqaloo lawla yateena biayatin min rabbihi awalam tatihim bayyinatu ma fee alssuhufi aloola

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوۡ أَنَّآ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُم بِعَذَابࣲ مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ لَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا لَوۡلَآ أَرۡسَلۡتَ إِلَيۡنَا رَسُولࣰ ا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَٰتِكَ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخۡزَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Walaw anna ahlaknahum biAAathabin min qablihi laqaloo rabbana lawla arsalta ilayna rasoolan fanattabiAAa ayatika min qabli an nathilla wanakhza

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses before we were humiliated and disgraced

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ كُلࣱّ مُّتَرَبِّصࣱ فَتَرَبَّصُواْۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٱلسَّوِيِّ وَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ
ayahs.translit: Qul kullun mutarabbisun fatarabbasoo fasataAAlamoona man ashabu alssirati alssawiyyi wamani ihtada

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, "Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided
